notes: SoundTrail research standard v2 now requires at least two verified Spotify track examples for every listed instrument/style relationship.
The existing SoundTrail catalog has been expanded to meet the new two-example minimum across accordion, clarinet, pedal steel guitar, cello, sitar, double bass, and tabla.
Future instruments must include importance, researched styles, role explanations, provenance, and two verified track examples per style before catalog validation will pass.
